Towers gain access to all detections at the start of the wave.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''The Sun''' is one of the curses that appears in the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be voted for by the players every few waves. If voted for, it will apply immunities to enemies and detections to towers. ==Effects== When applied, all enemies will gain the [[Stun Immunity]], [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Burn Immunity]]. This makes them partially immune to stalls, fully immune to knockback, fully immune to freeze and fully immune to burn, making it harder to stall them or reduce their [[Defense]]. To compensate, every tower will gain flying, lead and hidden detections if it did not have it already at the start of each wave. Upgrading certain towers that have detections granted by '''The Sun''' will cause it to lose the detections until the start of the next wave. Players also need to wait until the start of the next wave if they place down a tower that does not naturally have detections granted by '''The Sun'''. ==Trivia== *'''The Sun''' is based on the [[wp:The Sun (tarot card)|The Sun]] tarot card. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''The Sun''' added. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[V1.80.0|v1.80.1d]] ** '''The Sun''' removed. {{ModifierNavBox}}
